## Privacy & Security Checklist (auto-checked by `/sbd-check`)

> Tick what applies. If a row doesn't apply to this PR, write "n/a — <reason>".

### Data model changes (DPDP §8, ISO 27001 A.5.34)

- [ ] No new personal-data field introduced, OR new fields classified in `privacy-security-manifest.yaml`
- [ ] No new table holding personal data, OR `retentionDays` and `consentRequired` set for it
- [ ] If sensitive-personal added, manifest `consentBasis` is `explicit`

### Code-path changes

- [ ] Any new endpoint mutating data calls `auditLog.event(...)`
- [ ] Any new AI inference call is wrapped in `decisionLog(...)`
- [ ] Any code path on children's data uses `childrenGate.verifyParentalConsent(...)` first
- [ ] Any cross-border data flow declared in `manifest.crossBorder.destinations[]`

### Logging & errors (ISO 27001 A.8.11)

- [ ] No raw user-object logging; all logs route through `audit_log.ts`
- [ ] Healthcare code: errors run through `phiRedact(...)` before logging or external sinks

### Authorisation (ISO 27001 A.5.15 / A.8.3)

- [ ] New permission checks use `requirePermission(...)` from `rbac.ts`
- [ ] No bypass of RBAC via raw role-string comparison

### Secrets & crypto (NIST SSDF PS.1.1, ISO 27001 A.8.24)

- [ ] No hardcoded secrets (the pre-commit hook should have caught these)
- [ ] No DIY crypto / weak algorithms (MD5, SHA-1, DES, custom AES)

### Provenance (NIST SSDF PS.3.1)

- [ ] Every commit in this PR carries `[human]`, `[ai-human-pair]`, or `[ai:<model-id>]`
